Map any indicator by province or municipality

Source: R/plot_demog.R
map_indicator.Rd

General-purpose choropleth: joins a tidy indicator tibble (keyed by GEOID, matching get_ine_geo()'s output — e.g. get_ine_demog()'s output already has it) onto province or municipality geometry and renders it, either as a binned/discrete-legend map (the default, matching the classic "N provinces above/below a threshold" style of choropleth) or a continuous gradient. map_life_expectancy() is a thin wrapper around this function for System B's life-table output.

map_indicator(
  df,
  value_col,
  geo_level = c("province", "municipality"),
  region = NULL,
  binned = TRUE,
  breaks = NULL,
  palette = if (binned) "PiYG" else "D",
  moveCAN = TRUE,
  can_gap_km = 60,
  legend_title = NULL,
  title = NULL
)

Arguments

df

A tibble with a GEOID column (matching get_ine_geo()'s GEOID for the requested geo_level) and value_col.

value_col

Character, the name of the numeric column to map.

geo_level

Character, one of "province" or "municipality".

region

Optional character vector to subset the geometry by region name (regular expressions allowed). See get_ine_geo().

binned

Logical (default TRUE). If TRUE, uses a discrete, binned color scale (ggplot2::scale_fill_fermenter()) — a fixed number of color bands with a legend showing each band's range, matching the classic choropleth style. If FALSE, uses a continuous gradient (ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c() by default).

breaks

Numeric vector of bin edges when binned = TRUE. If NULL (default), computed automatically via pretty().

palette

Character, a RColorBrewer palette name when binned = TRUE (default "PiYG", a pink-to-green diverging palette well suited to ratios centered on 1) or a viridis option letter when binned = FALSE (default "D").

moveCAN

Logical, shift the Canary Islands next to the mainland (default TRUE). See get_ine_geo().

can_gap_km

Numeric, gap in km for the shifted Canary Islands (default 60). See get_ine_geo().

legend_title

Optional legend title (defaults to value_col).

title

Optional plot title.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Not run: get_ine_geo() requires live network access to fetch boundaries.
pop_data <- get_ine_demog(indicator = "population_total", year = 2023)
map_indicator(pop_data, "population_total", geo_level = "province")
} # }
